description: A number passes closed-term recognition exactly when it codes a term whose only variable names represent auxiliary constants.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.named_term_recognition_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (e : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.namedTerm S e = true ↔
    ∃ t, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.termCode S Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.auxName t = e
